findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of this compilation, which includes diagnostics created with a null location. Diagnostics reported at no location (for example when GetIdentifierLocation returns null) are now silently suppressed. Some of these protect users from insecure or unsupported configurations. Scope is mostly limited to metadata types, which L8 says are deliberately not analysed, so the practical impact on security protections is small.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the analyzer tests for MsgPack003/004/005/008/016 on source-declared types and confirm that every previously expected diagnostic is still reported. Add a case with a diagnostic at a null location and see whether it is dropped.
